from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,time,json,threading,hashlib,datetime
r=Path('/home/claude/code/EKA2L1-sky-performance');s=Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-sky-performance');old=Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-benchmark')
archives={'live':s/'untouched-live-20261002-control','control':s/'candidate-sync-v28c','cohorts':s/'candidate-sync-v28c'}
schedule=[dict(batch=batch,route=route,build=build)for batch in range(2)for route,order in [('sky',['live','control','cohorts']),('combat',['cohorts','live','control']),('standard',['control','cohorts','live']),('long',['live','cohorts','control'])]for build in (order if batch==0 else order[::-1])]
plan=s/'total-cohorts-v28c-plan.json';assert not plan.exists()
plan.write_text(json.dumps({'schedule':schedule,'fixed_before_first_sample':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'purpose':'24 serial observations: untouched live, same new binary normal policy with groups off/on. Reverse all route orders in second batch. Preserve all samples and original limits. Compiled SVC/exclusive/memory-miss/first-use options disabled in both new-binary configurations. Separately accepted exact live gates are reused from byte-identical archive. No correctness, census, build or profile jobs may overlap.','archives':{k:{'path':str(v),'wasm_sha256':hashlib.sha256((v/'eka2l1.wasm').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'provenance':json.loads((v/'provenance.json').read_text())}for k,v in archives.items()}},indent=2))
assert json.loads((s/'v28c-all-accepted.json').read_text())['replays']==7
live_hash=hashlib.sha256((archives['live']/'eka2l1.wasm').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert hashlib.sha256((s/'served-v28c-check.wasm').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==live_hash
for route in ['sky','combat']:
 assert json.loads((s/f'live-v8-gate-{route}-compare.json').read_text())['match']
 assert json.loads((s/f'live-v8-gate-{route}/report.json').read_text())['wasm_sha256']==live_hash
base={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items()if not k.startswith('EKA2L1_')}
base.update(EKA2L1_BENCHMARK_AOT='5',EKA2L1_AOT_IR_MODE='7',EKA2L1_AOT_EAGER_REGIONS='0',EKA2L1_TLB_HASH='1',EKA2L1_CODE_COMPARE='2',EKA2L1_CODE_LOOKUP='0',EKA2L1_PREDICATED_LEAVES='1',EKA2L1_LEAF_FEATURES='128',EKA2L1_UNSAFE_CODE='3',EKA2L1_SHARED_AUDIO='1',EKA2L1_EXECUTION_LIMITS='512,16,8,512',EKA2L1_GPU='hardware',EKA2L1_PROFILE_DETAIL='0')
rows=[]
for index,job in enumerate(schedule):
 route=job['route'];build=job['build'];name=f'total-cohorts-v28c-{index:02d}-{route}-{build}'
 env=dict(base,EKA2L1_WASM_BUILD_DIR=str(archives[build]))
 if build!='live':
  env.update(EKA2L1_THUMB_MEMORY='1',EKA2L1_ARM_MEMORY='0',EKA2L1_ROM_LEAVES='0',EKA2L1_ROM_CALLS='0',EKA2L1_ARM_EXCLUSIVE='0',EKA2L1_COMPILED_SVC='0',EKA2L1_COMPILED_MEMORY_MISSES='0',EKA2L1_SYNCHRONOUS_COMPILATION='0',EKA2L1_ROM_DISPATCH='2'if build=='cohorts'else'0')
 if route in ('sky','combat'):
  assets=s/'assets';start=28000000 if route=='sky'else 42000000;end=start+6000000
  inp=r/('src/tests/benchmark/sky-force.input'if route=='sky'else'src/tests/benchmark/sky-force-combat.input')
  env.update(EKA2L1_APP_UID='0xa020d913',EKA2L1_ASSET_MANIFEST=str(r/'src/tests/benchmark/sky-force-assets.json'))
 else:
  assets=old/'assets';start=21000000 if route=='standard'else 42000000;end=start+18000000
  inp=r/('src/tests/benchmark/snakes.input'if route=='standard'else'src/tests/benchmark/snakes-length-long.input')
 env.update(EKA2L1_PROFILE_START_US=str(start),EKA2L1_PROFILE_INPUT=str(inp))
 args=['node','profile.ts',str(assets),str(s/name),'1','0',str(end)]
 meta=dict(job,index=index,name=name,started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),command=args,env={k:v for k,v in env.items()if k.startswith('EKA2L1_')},git_head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=r,text=True).strip())
 (s/(name+'-command.json')).write_text(json.dumps(meta,indent=2));stop=threading.Event()
 def observer():
  with(s/(name+'-host.jsonl')).open('w')as f:
   while not stop.is_set():
    f.write(json.dumps({'utc':time.time(),'loadavg':Path('/proc/loadavg').read_text().strip(),'cpu':Path('/proc/stat').read_text().splitlines()[0],'temps':{str(p):p.read_text().strip()for p in Path('/sys/class/thermal').glob('thermal_zone*/temp')}})+'\n');f.flush();stop.wait(2)
 thread=threading.Thread(target=observer);thread.start();print(name+' START',flush=True);began=time.monotonic()
 try:
  with(s/(name+'.log')).open('w')as f:subprocess.run(args,cwd=r/'src/tests/wasm',env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True,timeout=1800)
 finally:stop.set();thread.join()
 report=json.loads((s/name/'report.json').read_text());m=report['measurement']
 assert report['unsafe_code']==3 and not report['sampling'] and report['shared_audio'] and not m['detailed'] and 'NVIDIA'in report['renderer']
 assert report['wasm_sha256']==hashlib.sha256((archives[build]/'eka2l1.wasm').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 if build=='live':assert report['thumb_memory']==-1 and report['rom_dispatch'] is None
 else:
  assert report['thumb_memory']==1 and report['rom_dispatch']==(2 if build=='cohorts'else 0)
  for key in ['arm_memory','rom_leaves','rom_calls','arm_exclusive','compiled_svc','compiled_memory_misses','synchronous_compilation']:assert report[key]==0
 row=dict(meta,command_seconds=time.monotonic()-began,wall_seconds=m['wall_seconds'],guest_seconds=(m['last_virtual_us']-m['first_virtual_us'])/1e6,instructions=m['last_instructions']-m['first_instructions'],presentations=m['presentations'],warmup_seconds=report['warmup_seconds'],runtime_footprint=report['runtime_footprint'])
 rows.append(row);(s/'total-cohorts-v28c.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2));print(name+' PASS '+str(row['wall_seconds']),flush=True)
for route in ['sky','combat','standard','long']:
 selected=[q for q in rows if q['route']==route]
 assert len({q['instructions']for q in selected})==1 and len({q['presentations']for q in selected})==1
(s/'total-cohorts-v28c-complete.json').write_text(json.dumps({'completed':len(rows)}))
scripts.record_total_cohorts_v28c.py:
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess
s=Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-sky-performance');r=Path('/home/claude/code/EKA2L1-sky-performance')
assert json.loads((s/'total-cohorts-v28c-complete.json').read_text())['completed']==24
rows=json.loads((s/'total-cohorts-v28c.json').read_text());assert len(rows)==24
panels=[]
for route in ['sky','combat','standard','long']:
 for batch in range(2):
  selection=[x for x in rows if x['route']==route and x['batch']==batch];assert len(selection)==3
  assert len({x['instructions']for x in selection})==len({x['presentations']for x in selection})==len({x['guest_seconds']for x in selection})==1
  by={x['build']:x for x in selection};l,c,v=[by[x]['wall_seconds']for x in ['live','control','cohorts']]
  panels.append(dict(route=route,batch=batch,order=[x['build']for x in selection],live=l,control=c,cohorts=v,cohorts_vs_control=100*(c/v-1),cohorts_vs_live=100*(l/v-1),control_vs_live=100*(l/c-1),realtime={k:x['guest_seconds']/x['wall_seconds']for k,x in by.items()}))
e={'plan':json.loads((s/'total-cohorts-v28c-plan.json').read_text()),'rows':rows,'panels':panels,'reports':{x['name']:json.loads((s/x['name']/'report.json').read_text())for x in rows},'host':{x['name']:(s/(x['name']+'-host.jsonl')).read_text()for x in rows},'reused_live_gates':{route:json.loads((s/f'live-v8-gate-{route}-compare.json').read_text())for route in ['sky','combat']},'scripts':{n:(s/n).read_text()for n in ['screen_total_cohorts_v28c.py','record_total_cohorts_v28c.py']}}
out=r/'src/tests/benchmark';(out/'ROM_STATE_COHORT_TOTAL_TIMING_EVIDENCE.json').write_text(json.dumps(e,indent=2))
lines=['# Bounded state retention and total-change timing','','All 24 preplanned serial observations retained. Each route reverses its three-build order in the second batch. Normal Chromium, NVIDIA hardware, no CPU sampling or detailed counters; no owned builds, correctness or diagnostic jobs overlap. Original execution limits and guest scheduling retained. The old live archive lacks the experimental APIs, so its absent readbacks are retained as null, not fabricated. Its prior exact Sky Force gates are reused from the byte-identical archive; the served WASM was freshly hash-verified before this panel.','','The new binary runs the normal speed policy: Thumb memory enabled; first-use compilation, compiled SVC/exclusive/memory-miss policies, ARM memory and ROM leaf/call experiments disabled. Only ROM dispatch 0 versus 2 differs between matching control and cohort candidate. This panel includes accumulated binary growth and other changes in the comparisons against untouched live.','','| Route | Batch | Order | Live s | New control s | Cohorts s | Cohorts vs control | Cohorts vs live | Control vs live |','|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|']
for x in panels:lines.append(f"| {x['route']} | {x['batch']} | {' / '.join(x['order'])} | {x['live']:.5f} | {x['control']:.5f} | {x['cohorts']:.5f} | {x['cohorts_vs_control']:+.2f}% | {x['cohorts_vs_live']:+.2f}% | {x['control_vs_live']:+.2f}% |")
lines+=['','Unpaced gameplay capacity (guest seconds divided by measured wall seconds):','','| Route | Live realtime | New control realtime | Cohort realtime |','|---|---:|---:|---:|']
for route in ['sky','combat','standard','long']:
 selection=[x for x in panels if x['route']==route]
 spans=[]
 for build in ['live','control','cohorts']:
  values=[x['realtime'][build]for x in selection];spans.append(f'{min(values):.3f}-{max(values):.3f}x')
 lines.append('| '+route+' | '+' | '.join(spans)+' |')
lines+=['','Startup and whole-command costs are separate from the gameplay interval. Warmup starts after the emulator run call returns; whole-command time includes browser initialization, assets, warmup, gameplay and export. WASM allocator footprint excludes browser/JIT memory. Cumulative installations include replaced functions; they are not a live-slot count.','','| Observation | Warmup s | Whole command s | Cumulative installations | WASM allocated bytes |','|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|']
for x in rows:lines.append(f"| {x['name']} | {x['warmup_seconds']:.3f} | {x['command_seconds']:.3f} | {x['runtime_footprint']['compiled_functions']} | {x['runtime_footprint']['allocated_bytes']} |")
lines+=['','All guest instruction, guest-time and presentation totals agree within each comparison. These finite routes and samples do not guarantee a universal gain or sustained live/audio realtime. Review all observations before selection. No outlier is removed. No deployment or push is implied.']
(out/'ROM_STATE_COHORT_TOTAL_TIMING_RESULTS.md').write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n');print(json.dumps(panels,indent=2))
